_readme: Curation for surveys/index.html. The page lists every public Survey123 form in TRPA's ArcGIS Online org live; this file only groups, describes, and hides them. A public form missing from 'surveys' still shows, under 'other'. 'past': true moves a form to Past surveys even if Survey123 still accepts responses (most TRPA forms are never closed). A form whose Survey123 schedule end date has passed, or that is set to Closed in Survey123, goes to Past on its own.
